name: extensions
sql: create extension if not exists pg_cron; create extension if not exists pg_net; select extname from pg_extension where extname in ('pg_cron','pg_net') order by 1

name: selftest_send
sql: do $$ begin if stale_watch.send('selftest', 'selftest', E'Stennisfy data-staleness watch: TEST PING\n\nInstalled in Supabase pg_cron: every 10 min it reads https://michaeldk1996.github.io/SAAS/build-info.json and alerts this chat when the published data is more than 60 min old (then at most hourly), or when the file cannot be read twice in a row. No action needed.') is null then raise exception 'selftest ping not queued: %', (select delivery from stale_watch.messages where kind = 'selftest' order by id desc limit 1); end if; end $$; select 'queued' as selftest

name: selftest_delivered
sql: do $$ declare d text := (select delivery from stale_watch.messages where kind = 'selftest' order by id desc limit 1); begin if d is distinct from 'sent' then raise exception 'selftest ping not confirmed sent: %', d; end if; end $$; select 'sent' as selftest

name: checks
sql: select id, fired_at, status_code, built_at, error from stale_watch.checks order by fired_at desc limit 3

name: job
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname = 'stale_watch_10min'
